title: Observability: FIPS gate failure during ioctl_init emits no log
description: In ioctl_init() (crypto2dev_fd.c lines 655-661), when ops->fips_gate() returns non-zero the handler silently calls module_put() and returns the gate error code with no pr_err identifying the algo or provider. The CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_STATUS path correctly logs the provider name on gate failure, but the per-session ioctl_init path does not. A support engineer diagnosing why INIT returns -EACCES for a given algo gets no kernel log to work from.
close_reason: fixed: FIPS gate failure in ioctl_init now emits pr_err naming algo and provider; explicitly returns -EACCES
